note: The input-controlled MLE TLV header is read from the received radio message into the project TLV object, including the attacker-supplied length byte.
Only the bounded local object size is copied, but the copied TLV header still carries the original input length for later consumers.

code: bool IsValid(void) const { return GetLength() >= sizeof(*this) - sizeof(Tlv); }
note: The validation requires only a minimum Response TLV length and fails to enforce the maximum size of mResponse before the length is used for comparison.
The oversized TLV length controls the memcmp byte count, causing a read past the fixed stack ResponseTlv buffer.
